_doc: Black 2's Unova / Juniper lines a Sinnoh player can read: the Bag's item refusal (Pearl bank 199 line 36: Rowan), the title menu's UNOVA LINK label, the Medal Box's lines about the regional Pokédex, walking, flying and visiting (title_11 descriptions, title_12 hints, medal_names), and two help pages (title_8). Medals of Unova's own places (bridges, PWT, Royal Unova, Unova's Challenge) keep Black 2's words: they can't be earned here. Packed by patches/sinnoh_names.py.

title_8.Title8_Text_CanRestoreTiredPokemon:
You can restore your tired Pokémon and buy
useful items. You'll find the PC where you
can keep captured Pokémon.

You can hear
Professor Rowan's evaluation
of your Pokédex.

Visit 2F for Link Trade and Link Battle.
title_8.Title8_Text_UnovaRegionHasEight:
The Sinnoh region has eight Gyms. Each Gym
has its own Gym Leader, and you can win
Gym Badges by defeating those Gym Leaders.


You can tap the icon in the bottom-left
corner of the Trainer Card screen to check
how many Gym Badges you have.
